source_generator.design: Domain separated deterministic development fixtures; source IDs include family, split, observed relation codes, public relation mapping, ground-truth identity and regime; no prospective seed or generator is provided.

controls.information_exposure: All arms receive only identical opaque observed propositions and explicitly allowed code-to-predicate mapping; no ground-truth oracle case is passed through the model callback.
controls.known_mapping_control: Fully informed canonical and rule baselines preserve exact structured semantics on synthetic DEV; this is an intentionally saturated semantic-ceiling control.
controls.withheld_mapping_control: Without a code-to-predicate mapping, registered noncandidate baselines abstain or fail to satisfy exact semantic correctness; do not count these examples as comparable learnable transfer.
controls.candidate_status: Callback/fit interface only. No learning mechanism trained or qualified; development placeholder abstains.
controls.sandbox_limitation: This stage validates interface and data-flow contract but does not enforce a hardened process sandbox for arbitrary third-party callbacks; prospective evaluation requires separate input-isolated execution.

adversarial_controls: Reject modified graph/truth hashes and public relation mapping
Reject duplicate/overlapping or missing source fixtures
Reject DEV_CHECK input at fit time
Require explicit abstentions and full case denominators
Never save raw truth/predictions in qualification receipts
qualification.initial_failure: Initial qualification run 40085102168 failed a synthetic-only typo using dev-negation rather than frozen dev-polarity family; source generator and scientific requirements unchanged. Test corrected and fully requalified run 40085150302.

research_interpretation.bounded_achievement: Development-only source and information budget custody qualified with reproducible cross-OS hashes and matched exposed code/lexicon for all registered arms.
not_demonstrated: Semantic performance of fluent unrestricted prose
Information acquisition from observations in a new world

next_active_gate: L10-B successor: qualify independently specified prospective source-family generator identity, one-time secret/seed custody, matched training exposures, trained candidate and strong conventional controls; avoid generating protected test examples before admission. Then separate L10-C first-use qualification.
